title: The glass backbone: Why the Army's logistics will break in the next war
summary: This article from the Modern War Institute analyzes critical vulnerabilities in US Army logistics infrastructure, arguing that current supply chain systems are fragile and would fail under modern warfare conditions with advanced missile systems and contested environments.
problem_solved: Identifies systemic weaknesses in military logistics that would cause breakdown under peer-state warfare scenarios.
why_valuable: Provides critical analysis of defense preparedness gaps, offering insights for military strategists and policymakers to address critical infrastructure vulnerabilities before potential conflicts.
